text.description_html:
Acorn RH8BQ, 7" Rough Iron H-L Hinge

For over a half a century authenticity and function have been the way Acorn Manufacturing has produced some of the highest quality forged hardware and accessories from some of New England's finest Blacksmiths. The 7 Inch Rough Iron H-L Hinge is forged with this legacy in mind. For interior and exterior doors, the rough iron finish duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals by imitating the texture of naturally weathered of iron. It has a lifetime no rust warranty.

Also Available Matching: 4-1/2" Rough Iron H-L Hinge

Specifications of the 7" Rough Black Iron Hinge:

  • Height: 7"
  • Overall Width: 6-3/8"
  • Hinge Leaf Width: 7/8"

Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Priced and sold as a pair. (2-hinges).
